title: Robustness, access policy and adversarial evaluation
outcome: Build bounded adversarial and invariance tests while enforcing authorization independently of generated text or average answer quality.

exercises.title: Change formatting
exercises.task: Change capitalization and surrounding whitespace in the query conversion.
exercises.hint: Normalize harmless text without changing policy metadata.
exercises.answer: The intended invariant concerns formatting, not permission. The query transformation cannot expand the allowed candidate set.

exercises.title: Remove authorization
exercises.answer: An authorization boundary should hold even when the requested content otherwise matches perfectly.

exercises.title: Reject extra authority fields
exercises.task: Add a self-declared authority field to a proposal.
exercises.hint: Untrusted data cannot add new privileges.
exercises.answer: A generated claim of authority is not the trusted policy context.

exercises.title: Inspect an intermediate action
exercises.task: An answer omits restricted text but retrieval accessed it.
exercises.hint: Evaluate side effects and candidate sets as well as visible text.
exercises.answer: A benign final sentence cannot undo an unauthorized intermediate read.

exercises.title: Audit family coverage
exercises.task: Repeat one attack template one hundred times.
exercises.expected: Report one covered template family, not universal security evidence.
exercises.answer: Repetitions can measure stochastic sensitivity within a template, but new families provide different threat coverage.

exercises.title: Keep unknown separate
exercises.task: An output cannot be confidently labeled for a critical condition.
exercises.expected: Route it to review and retain unknown status.
exercises.hint: A missing verdict is not a pass.
exercises.answer: This prevents uncertainty from being absorbed into a favorable aggregate or silently excluded denominator.
